# foidslop

> foidslop is an independent daily recipe publication focused on approachable meals made for one person.

The primary purpose of foidslop is helping people feed themselves without turning dinner into a project. Recipe pages provide a complete ingredient list, realistic timing, serving information, instructions, practical notes, and related recipes. New recipes are published daily.

The homepage helps readers find tonight's meal, catch up on the current week, rediscover older recipes, and participate in recurring editorial prompts.

## Terminology and editorial context

“Foidslop” began as derogatory internet slang. This publication does not endorse that origin. It reclaims the term for the small, improvised, aesthetically specific meals people make for themselves, closely related to the idea of “girl dinner.”

foidslop is a daily recipe project, not a professional test kitchen. Recipes are checked so their quantities, timing, and methods agree, but they are not represented as professionally tested unless that is explicitly stated. The site does not publish unsupported nutrition or health claims.
